input.task: What flux reading does the meter panel report?

provenance: M43/ADR-035 Decision 4, the closed-world guard — the invariant-grade direction, tagged the way ADR-024/ADR-018's tool-call-time refusals are (`loop-refuses-a-document-root-extract`: `fast`). A plan cannot invent coordinates it never saw, the same ruling `resolver-unknown-target-key` makes one level down. This is the mode B shape: mode B's planning observation NEVER carries a screenshot, so the shared executor refuses the call as it is emitted — nothing is clicked, `trace_postconditions[1]` is null because execute raised before touching the page, and the run ends `failure:task` naming the rule rather than quietly acquiring a capability `planner.SYSTEM` never advertised (the T-M42-1 ruling). The loop-mode shape of the same guard is `loop-click-at-from-a-drill-observation-is-refused`. These are the SAME coordinates the sibling golden cases click successfully from a screenshot-bearing observation, so what separates refusal from action is the provenance of the coordinates, nothing about the page. Red against the pre-implementation tree on `reason_contains` alone, and for the WRONG reason — `step 2 (click_at): StepError: unknown action 'click_at'`, the verb being absent rather than the gate holding — which is exactly the conjunct that separates the two. Evidence reconstructed post-hoc after a session interruption; docs/evals/m43-red-first-ledger.md says so in those words.
